A further targeted search of RRK for code 29690, Gazette issue 23159, publication date 1403/07/10, and the sending-letter number returned no additional indexed official record. This does not change the verification status.

The old RRK endpoint is not the only route: a report dated 1403/08/29 identifies a newer Official Gazette portal at https://rrk.ir/ords/r/rrs/rrs-front/home. A technical review of the public rrk-mcp repository identified the new RRK APEX search page path https://rrk.ir/ords/r/rrs/rrs-front/ghavanin-moghararat and AJAX path https://rrk.ir/ords/wwv_flow.ajax. These are third-party code-derived technical leads, not official API documentation; direct page retrieval from this environment still timed out, and no record or Gazette image was retrieved.

The qavanin-mcp public repository was inspected only to understand possible Qavanin retrieval paths and amendment-history capabilities. The official Qavanin precedent page still returned only a transfer page in this environment; no new primary legal text was retrieved.

Both current third-party packages rrk-mcp and qavanin-mcp declare PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 and require a separate commercial license for commercial use. Because Vakil-Yar is intended as a commercial product, neither package nor its code/dependencies is adopted or installed; no code was copied into this repository.
